rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides building code lookup and compliance checking for residential construction projects, integrating with the National Electrical Code (NEC), International Residential Code (IRC), and International Plumbing Code (IPC). Features natural language code search, specific section retrieval, compliance verification for described scenarios, and category browsing through a JSON-based database with plans to migrate to vector search. Useful for DIY enthusiasts, contractors, and construction guidance while emphasizing the need for professional verification and local jurisdiction compliance.
